_doc: Authoritative Adwerx campaign registry. The Friday tracker only tracks campaigns listed here with status launched/paused/stopped. Kate (or Howard) flips status to 'launched' and sets launchedDate when a campaign actually goes live in Adwerx. The weekly engine adds 'proposed' entries; humans promote them to 'approved' then 'launched'.

_schema.name: human-readable campaign name
_schema.utmCampaign: exact utm_campaign value; GA4 join key
_schema.utmId: exact utm_id value (same as id); GA4 sessionManualCampaignId join key
_schema.adwerxCampaignId: the NATIVE campaign ID assigned by Adwerx at launch (recorded during preflight); exact non-fuzzy join path for Adwerx reports; null until launched
_schema.baselineRef: path to the immutable pre-launch baseline snapshot (baselines/<id>.md), committed before approval; null until baselined
_schema.creativeVersion: v1, v2... bump when creative rotates
_schema.primaryGoal: the GA4 event that counts as the campaign's qualified outcome
_schema.launchedDate: YYYY-MM-DD or null (real launch date; tracker age uses this)
_schema.actualBudget: USD/month actually set in Adwerx, or null
_schema.status: proposed | approved | launched | paused | stopped | expired | rejected | superseded
_schema.lifecycle: proposed reserves budget 7 days, revalidated weekly (renew or expire); approved gets 14-day launch deadline then APPROVAL STALE; rejected/skipped/superseded are permanent history
